english: 'Our reporter, Alan Jones, has been watching the cheese being made.
text: watching the cheese being made 看的是奶酪正在制作的过程，being made 同时保留进行和被动含义。如果只说 watching the cheese，就只是在看成品或奶酪本身，没有制作过程这层信息。
